A round of fresh-install fixes reported on the Unraid forum and GitHub, plus optional web-office editing.

## Fixed

- **Files showed up but were greyed out and could not be opened or downloaded.** The template shipped the storage driver blank, and OpenCloud reads a set-but-empty variable as an explicit override, which wiped its built-in `posix` default with an empty value. The template now sets `posix` explicitly. The unsupported `local` driver breaks the same way, so never use it. If your install already ran with a blank or `local` driver, set the driver to `posix` and start with a fresh Data folder, because the on-disk layout is fixed at first init.
- **A fresh install crashed the gateway with "invalid IP-literal".** The Public URL default used Unraid's [IP] and [PORT] tokens, which Unraid only substitutes in the WebUI field, not in environment variables, so OpenCloud received the literal text. The default is now a real editable placeholder, and the container falls back to its own IP if it is left unset, so it boots instead of crash-looping.
- **A fresh install could hang during the one-time init.** The init step opened an interactive prompt when it did not get a clear answer for the self-signed certificate; with no terminal that prompt spun forever. The container now always answers it non-interactively.

## Added

- **Optional web office (advanced, default off).** Set the "Web office suite" dropdown to `collabora` or `onlyoffice`, fill in your document-server URL and a WOPI secret, and the wrapper turns on OpenCloud's built-in collaboration (WOPI) service and registers the editor. The document server itself (Collabora Online / CODE, or an OnlyOffice / Euro Office Document Server) runs as a separate container. See the README "Web office" section for the setup and reverse-proxy notes.

## Notes

- The `posix` storage driver needs a Data volume on a filesystem with extended-attribute support (the Unraid array and cache/pool disks have it).
